def: The full record of one request: input, prompts, model and tool calls, retrieved documents and final output, in order.
A short list of named failure kinds, with counts, built from reading real outputs.
A language model prompted to grade another system's output against a written criterion.
A set of tests, often built from past failures, that fails if an old problem returns.
The cycle of looking at traces, naming failures, measuring them, changing the system and guarding the fix.
